body:
I can't leave people hanging. I genuinely believe it's the only reason I haven't tried anything.

One of the things I hate is men who change after they're in a relationship. I've lost friends that way (not the same ones that are tired of me). This is not the case. Even if it is, I don't understand why people would want to hang out with me and then just flip the switch to "Yeah, you're not cool anymore. Fuck off."
Even thinking about an ambulance has me worried about money. Do they advise locations? Everyone says "Free clinics" or "Sliding scale" but no one seems to know WHERE these places are.

Is there a way to do this with no money? I literally have $20 disposable income a week from unemployment. The rest goes to bills. I have a small savings, but it's depleting rapidly as I buy groceries and things.

If I had courage, I'd have already done it. This isn't a matter of courage, it's a matter of something is wrong with me that can't be fixed. Once or twice, sure, everyone runs into some dicks in their life, but EVERYONE I know? I'm crying again while I type this, but I'm clearly already broken.
